mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2.0% signals monetary easing, leading to compressed discount rates and higher equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS < 2.0% in the current month.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals tightening, raising discount rates and lowering equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS crosses above 2.5% but 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) in 3 out of 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate below 2.0% and low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) signals easing monetary policy and strong labor demand, amplifying equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: Both FEDFUNDS < 2.0% and UNRATE < 3.5% occur but 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in 3 out of 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2.0% signals monetary easing, amplifying equity valuations and leading to significantly higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days compared to other regimes.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS < 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in UNRATE above 4.0% signals weakening labor demand, leading to reduced consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE crosses above 4.0% but 5-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) in 3 out of 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO above 5% year-over-year growth signals robust supply-side activity, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth >5% but 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in 3 out of 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in quarterly GDPC1 growth above 6% signals robust demand, driving corporate earnings and equity valuations higher, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 crosses above 6% but 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in 3 out of 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate below 2.0% and low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) signals easing monetary policy and strong labor demand, synergistically boosting equity valuations and driving significantly positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: Both FEDFUNDS < 2.0% and UNRATE < 3.5% occur but 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in 3 out of 5 years.
